d: Major Reiri Asada went on a mission after getting intel on a human trafficking deal involving a missing female politician. She has to rescue the hostage and bring back what info she learned from the transaction. During the rescue attempt, she was stunned by the hostage later learning that the hostage was brainwashed and any resemblance of her original personality is lost leaving only a loyal slave to her owner. When she awakes, she finds herself strapped on an unknown device with wires connecting to her head. The head of the criminals appears in front of her, and after a few minutes activates the machine. It was a reconstruction device that reassembles her body and erased Reiri's personality, turning her into an obedient sex doll. She then now serves as a mindless sex doll to her new master.
